about: docs/motion.md. `valid`: a view that must check. `refusals`: a view (of component C, with the events Seen, Gone and Pick(v)) and the rule tag that refuses it; `program` is a whole program instead. Checked by crates/cancho-ui/tests/motion.rs.

valid.name: a Reveal with an id, inside a Reveal
a CountUp in a Heading, a Strong and a Link
valid.view: Heading { level: 2 CountUp { to: 5 } } Rich { Strong { CountUp { to: 6 } } Link { to: "https://example.org/" CountUp { to: 7 } } }

valid.name: visible and hidden on a section
valid.view: Section { visible: Seen hidden: Gone Text { "x" } }

valid.name: visible on an Article, an Aside and a Figure
valid.view: Article { visible: Seen Text { "x" } } Aside { hidden: Gone Text { "y" } } Figure { visible: Seen Text { "z" } }

refusals.name: visible names an event with a parameter
a section in a For
refusals.view: For { over: items as: m Section { visible: Seen Text { "x" } } }

refusals.name: a section in an If
refusals.view: If { when: shown Section { visible: Seen Text { "x" } } }

refusals.name: a section in a component that is not the mounted one
a page with nothing static to read is built by script, not hydrated
refusals.view: Section { visible: Seen Button { label: "b" on: Seen } }
